# James Gallagher Watchdog File

Subject: James Gallagher, Republican, CA, running for U.S. House district 1 in 2026
Current office: U.S. House CA-1
Compiled: 2026-10-23 for the On Point Politics watchdog database, onpointpolitics.us
Status: queued for hand research, priority 4. This file holds the roster facts, the office levers, and FEC pipeline data when the pipeline has run. It is not yet a finished Tier 2 profile.

## Race

Race status: advanced top two. Rating: Cook: Solid D. Current holder of the seat: James Gallagher.
Opponents: Mike McGuire, Democrat.
Roster note: won Jun 2026 special after LaMalfa death

## Committee assignments

- House Committee on Transportation and Infrastructure
- House Committee on Science, Space, and Technology
- House Committee on Foreign Affairs
